column1: # tools/copy-ban-allowlist.tsv -- recorded, dated debt against the copy gate.
# Read by tools/check-copy-banned-terms.sh. A row drops exactly one violation:
# it must match the ban row id, a substring of the file path, AND a substring of
# the offending string. All three, so a row cannot silently widen when the file
# is edited.
# THIS FILE IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY.
# The first real run of the gate over this repository found 41 violations across
# 12 of the 20 files in docs/assets/ -- 4 x "Swarm Team Six", 2 x "clowders",
# 4 x "hunt" as a noun, 14 x bare "lane", 7 x "trusted"/"proof", 2 x "approval",
# 2 x bare "lease", 4 x a bare source count. Every one is in an `aria-label` or a
# `<text>` node, i.e. in the exact strings that reach a screen reader or a
# rendered chart label.
# Those are not debt to allowlist. They are the reason 05 section 2.1 cannot say
# "the assets ship as they are": an asset carrying "Swarm Team Six" in its
# accessible name cannot appear in a console whose product name is Ambush. The
# PR that wires this gate rewrites those strings. See 16-INVARIANT-TESTS.md
# section 6.3 for the file-by-file list.
# If you are about to add a row here for PRODUCT copy, you are in the wrong
# file: change the string, or change tools/copy-ban-list.tsv and record it as a
# brief amendment under 00-BRIEF.md section 12.
